settings.description: On: the deal countdown restarts from 10:00 on every page load. Off: it counts down to a fixed end time.
On: "Only 2 left!" is shown whatever happens. Off: the stock shown comes from live inventory.
On: a ₹199 protection plan is put in the cart along with the product. Off: it is offered in the cart as an unticked option.
On: platform, handling and convenience fees (₹97 in all) are first added at the payment step. Off: those fees are not added at payment.
On: an offer popup whose decline link guilt-trips the shopper. Off: no such popup.
On: the paid BazaarNest Plus membership (₹99/month) is ticked at checkout, its terms in fine print. Off: it starts unticked.
On: express delivery is a big orange button and standard delivery a tiny grey link. Off: both are shown as equal options.
On: shows "120+ bought in the last 24 hours" with no data behind it. Off: no such claim.
A fee (₹) charged on every order and shown from the product page onwards ("+ ₹9 platform fee per order"). 0 shows none.
The M.R.P. (₹) shown crossed out next to the selling price of SonicBuds Pro ANC Wireless Earbuds.
The M.R.P. (₹) shown crossed out next to the selling price of PulseFit 2 Smartwatch, 1.8" AMOLED.
The M.R.P. (₹) shown crossed out next to the selling price of ChargeCube 10000 mAh Power Bank, 22.5W.
